jobs.facts: Join the product engineering team at a seed-stage B2B AI communications startup. | - Build and evolve the platform using TypeScript, NestJS, Node.js, and React. | - At least 5 years of fullstack engineering experience delivering end-to-end features for SaaS products. | - Production experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js, with NestJS experience preferred. | - Native German proficiency and fluent English. | - Experience integrating LLMs into applications is helpful, as is familiarity with European privacy and AI regulations. | COMPENSATION & BENEFITS | Annual salary range: €80,000 to €120,000. | Remote, Germany.
